# SnapshotMeta

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Document-level accessibility/compliance context, captured alongside the tree so the compliance evaluator can raise document-scoped findings (missing language, missing title, untagged document) without a second source of truth.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new SnapshotMeta()
```

## Properties

- [`AccessibilityMode`](#accessibilitymode): The document's declared AccessibilityMode as an int (0 = None, 1 = PdfUa1, 2 = PdfUa2).
- [`Conformance`](#conformance): The document's declared PDF/A conformance name (e.g. "None", "PdfA2b").
- [`Language`](#language): BCP-47 document language (/Lang), when declared.
- [`Title`](#title): Document title, when declared.
